pick.headline: Bomb destroys Israeli Embassy in Buenos Aires
pick.summary: On March 17, 1992, a suicide car bomb destroyed the Israeli Embassy in Buenos Aires, killing 29 people.
pick.significance: Islamic Jihad, linked to Hizballah, claimed it in apparent revenge for the killing of Abbas Musawi. Argentina later blamed Iran.
pick.fbis: The Latin America Daily Report of March 18, 1992, led its front page with TELAM: the March 17 explosion "virtually destroyed" the Israeli Embassy in Buenos Aires; Menem blamed remnants of Nazism and fundamentalist groups, and an anonymous caller claimed a pro-Palestinian group.

alternates.headline: Soviet referendum on preserving the union
alternates.summary: On March 17, 1991, Soviet citizens voted on preserving the USSR as a renewed federation; six republics boycotted the vote.
alternates.significance: A large majority voted yes, but the result could not stop the union's disintegration.
